name: Islamabad Serena Hotel
assumptions: Height is not published: seven levels counted in the garden photos (one Scribd source agrees), ground floor 5.6 m and upper floors 3.4 m are estimates from window pitch, so the roof is 26 m and arch crowns about 30 m.
Service towers to 33 and 31.5 m: two are seen above the roofline in photos, their positions and size are estimates.
The second pool block is not in OSM; it is placed from the Esri image with a roof-lean correction, and its plan is approximate.
West faces carry no timber screens or roof arches because the satellite shows plain wall there; those faces were not photographed from the ground.
Timber screen bays are repeated, five to a run, on every other long face; real runs vary between three and five and a few smaller ones are left out.
Roof arches: the interlaced double row is simplified to two straight rows 1.3 m apart.
The stacked central screens are placed on faces near the two re-entrant corners only; exact faces chosen from the two photos that show them.
Pool podium deck 12.5 m and pergola top 19.5 m are read from photos; pergola layout is simplified.
The sunken garden, sandstone retaining walls, small timber entrance pavilions, the separate red-roofed building and the Business Complex are left out.
Low wing at the west end taken as 6.5 m, from its small roof lean on the satellite.
